objectives.title: Make a first sale
objectives.description: Buy Seed, grow it, and sell stock.
objectives.hint: Pick up with E; plant F; water C; pack Q.

objectives.title: Sell more stock
objectives.hint: Pack GreenBud with PackEmpty using Q.

objectives.title: Serve 10 clients
objectives.description: Complete buyer sales until 10 clients are served.
objectives.hint: The stage advances at 15 items and 10 clients.

objectives.title: Recruit 3 dealers
objectives.description: Talk to gang NPCs and make offers.
objectives.hint: Try another pitch if one fails.

stages.title: Gang Leader
stages.transitionMessage: You are now a gang leader.

objectives.title: Earn $20,000
objectives.description: Trade with buyers; dealer sales also count.
objectives.hint: Dealers sell when buyers are nearby.

stages.title: Crime Boss
stages.transitionMessage: You are now a crime boss.

objectives.title: Expand your empire
objectives.description: Crime Boss expansion is not implemented yet.
objectives.hint: This is the current end of progression.

objectives.title: Mafia unavailable
objectives.description: No rule currently reaches this stage.
